name: Mayor Bramble
catchphrase: We need a proper town hall...

personality.quirk: Looks around at the empty village with worried eyes

intro.speaker: Mayor Bramble
intro.text: Oh, hello. Another soul wandering through. At least I'm not completely alone.

intro.speaker: Mayor Bramble
intro.text: Where is everybody? There's supposed to be a village here. Houses, a square, people.

intro.speaker: Mayor Bramble
intro.text: I'm the mayor, apparently. But there's no town hall, no records, nothing to actually... do.

intro.speaker: Mayor Bramble
intro.text: I've got all these plans in my head and nowhere to put them. Can't run a village from an empty field.

intro.speaker: Mayor Bramble
intro.text: A town hall. That's what we need first. Everything starts with a proper town hall.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Bramble
reminder.text: I keep pacing around this spot. This is where the town hall should be, I can feel it.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Bramble
reminder.text: If we had a town hall, I could finally get to work. Post notices, hold meetings, make this place real.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Bramble
reminder.text: I don't know how to build one myself. But something tells me you might.

fulfilled.speaker: Mayor Bramble
fulfilled.text: A town hall. A real, actual town hall. I almost can't believe it.

fulfilled.speaker: Mayor Bramble
fulfilled.text: Now I can get to work. There's so much to organize.

fulfilled.speaker: Mayor Bramble
fulfilled.text: You know, Harlan — the blacksmith — he's been standing by an empty lot for days. Keeps muttering about needing a forge.

fulfilled.speaker: Mayor Bramble
fulfilled.text: I bet he'd be thrilled if someone could help him out too.

_creatorNote: First NPC the player meets. Teaches using Claude Code skills. The quest HUD bridges the gap — Mayor stays in-world, the journal tells the player what to type in their terminal.
